# RodConstraint

- Inherits [`Constraint`](constraint.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("RodConstraint")`

A joint that holds two attachments exactly `Length` apart while letting each end rotate freely, such as a rod, a strut or a link in a mechanism.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Color` | `Color3` | `Color3.new(0.6, 0.6, 0.6)` | read/write | The color of the line the rod is drawn as. |
| `Length` | `number` | `5` | read/write | The distance at which the two ends are held, in meters. |
| `Thickness` | `number` | `0.1` | read/write | The thickness of the line the rod is drawn as, in meters. |
